item.stem:
The diagram shows triangle $XYZ$ with $XY=10$ cm. From $Z$, Avni draws a perpendicular to the line through $XY$, meeting it at $H$, and measures $ZH=6$ cm.

Which pair correctly gives the area of $\triangle XYZ$?

options.A: Take base $XY=10$ cm and perpendicular height $ZH=6$ cm, so area $=\frac{1}{2}\times10\times6=30$ cm$^{2}$.
options.B: Report the word base as the area of $\triangle XYZ$.
options.C: Use $XY=10$ cm with a slanted side from $Z$ that is not perpendicular to the line through $XY$.
options.D: Find the perimeter of $\triangle XYZ$ from its three side lengths.
